spatial_evaluation_21.metrics_source: metrics_by_group.csv (sha256 verified against the accepted 21 manifest)
spatial_evaluation_21.metrics_columns: n = scored cells (segment x day or x 6 h block); nonzero_cells = cells with >= 1 recorded+linked record; total_actual = recorded+linked records; total_pred = sum of predicted expected counts; bias = mean(pred - actual); wape with wape_status; metric_floor_* = the original metric-floor audit (cells floored, floored positive cells/records, floored deviance sum) where the method needed it
spatial_evaluation_21.metrics_note: selection is unchanged (accepted 21); the 2026 record diagnostic is reported separately under diagnostics_2026 and is outcome-conditioned

diagnostics_2026.record_meaning: one row of the official MOT CSV = one RAW OBSERVED RECORD. The file has no ACC_CODE, so unique physical-event identity is UNVERIFIED; exact full-row duplicates are the only deduplication
limits: January-September 2026 RAW OBSERVED-RECORD diagnostic of the official MOT snapshot; NOT a strict untouched test (2026 was audited before) and NOT a validated nationwide or complete-September evaluation.

Only observed POSITIVE eligible linked cells are scored (outcome-conditioned): zero labels, full calendar x segment population and unique physical-event identity (no ACC_CODE) are UNVERIFIED; missing cells stay unknown, never zero.
Provider checksum NOT verified (the CKAN hash differs from the downloaded file MD5 and the saved metadata does not name its algorithm); the local SHA-256 snapshot pin matches.
Raw strong-baseline deviance is +infinity where it predicts 0 on a positive cell: encoded as null with deviance_status; the original 1e-12 floor audit is reported separately with its floored counts.
caveats: RAW OBSERVED-RECORD diagnostic: no ACC_CODE, so unique physical-event identity and event-level deduplication are unverified; only exact full-row duplicates are removed.

Only observed POSITIVE eligible linked segment x date (or 6 h block) cells are scored. Full calendar x segment zero-label coverage is NOT verified; unobserved cells stay unknown (never zero). The cell selection is outcome-conditioned, so these metrics are biased and NOT comparable with the full-population 2022-23 OOF or 2024-25 seen diagnostics.

The snapshot (CKAN last_modified 2026-11-02) does not prove completeness; later arrivals after 2026-11-02 are unknown. The 30-day label availability of the old protocol is a research assumption that the measured report lag contradicts as a completeness claim; no reweighting or correction is applied.
2026 had earlier diagnostic data audits in this project; this is NOT a strict untouched test. The models were selected on 2022-23 OOF before any 2026 score.
Expected SELECTED+LINKED recorded-count rate per segment and horizon; not a probability, not a safety statement, no causal interpretation.
